To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the IRDS meta-pyramid is a good basis for the integration of MDE and ontology engineering.
Ontologies are no substitute for specifications, but they can be used as descriptive models.

(i) the IRDS metapyramids can be used as a basis for the development of ontology-aware mega-models, (ii) ontologies are a key element for the description of the MDA metapyramids, (iii) ontologies can be used for the specification of MDA metapyramid elements, and (iv) ontologies are not suitable for the specification of models and metamodels.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is an ontology?
a meta-level analysis of MDE, which is a prerequisite for a better understanding of MDE.
the following questions: (1) How can ontologies be integrated with the MDE paradigm?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MDE is a meta-model-driven development paradigm, and MDE is a model-driven development paradigm that uses ontologies as a meta-modeling tool.
the MDE paradigm is a promising candidate for a new software engineering paradigm, but it is not yet mature enough to be applied in practice.
MDE needs a comprehensive ontology-based meta-modeling framework, which must be developed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ontologies are not the silver bullet, but a useful tool for MDE.
the model-driven approach can be used to create a meta-model for the model-driven approach itself.
we have shown that ontologies can be used in the model-driven paradigm, but we have also shown that the current state of ontologies is not sufficient for this purpose.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have demonstrated that the model-driven approach can be applied to the development of ontologies, and vice versa, that ontologies can be applied to MDE.
the meta-models of the IRDS metapyramind should not only be extended but also be reorganized to better reflect the role of ontological knowledge in MDE.
we have demonstrated that the MDA and MDE paradigms are compatible with ontologies, and that ontologies can be employed to improve the quality of the MDA and the MDE paradigmes.
